zoe-finance: FYI we received a support ticket from Prism Labs (P-904). They report an unexplained spike in embed units on 2026-07-08 ~09:10Z. Can we confirm quickly whether this is a metering issue?
ben-sales: CSM attached their client logs showing repeated retries to our ingest endpoint during that minute. They asked for a ballpark credit and ETA.
li-platform: Quick triage: raw gateway traces show a partner proxy replaying identical payloads with new request_ids for ~8 minutes. Our ledger keys on request_id so each replay appears billable. We do capture client_payload_hash ~70% of the time which can be used to dedupe.
amy-billing: Can you run a short query to estimate duplicate units and USD impact? I can approve up to $4,000.
li-platform: Running quick aggregation. SQL snippet: ```SELECT client_payload_hash, count(*) as cnt, sum(embedding_units) as units FROM embed_raw WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2026-07-08T09:05:00Z' AND '2026-07-08T09:15:00Z' GROUP BY client_payload_hash HAVING count(*) > 1;```
ops-bot: quick-scan result: dup_rows=54, duplicated_units=123450, est_usd=1,234.50 (prelim). CSV export staged: https://internal.storage/exports/P-904-dup.csv
zoe-finance: That estimate is within approval. Proposal: issue provisional credit $1,235.00 (round up) and run an audit-only backfill to reconcile ledger. If backfill reduces amount, we'll adjust with a follow-up memo.
amy-billing: Approved. amy-billing approves provisional credit $1,235.00 to Prism Labs (P-904). Please attach the CSV and job id for audit.
li-platform: Backfill job BF-20260708-prism-dedupe created (audit-only). Runbook RB-embed-dedupe-006. Canary run scheduled first, then full replay. Estimate 3h including verification.
ben-sales: I'll notify CSM & customer: "We've issued a provisional credit of $1,235.00 while we run an internal reconciliation job. We'll confirm within 48 hours." :thumbsup:
zoe-finance: Please post the credit memo id and GL post timestamp when available so I can close the dispute ticket. Also open a PR to have routers emit dedupe_key consistently.
li-platform: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/emit-dedupe-key. Will attach final CSV + checksum after backfill completes.
ops-bot: job scheduled: https://jobs.internal/BF-20260708-prism-dedupe status=scheduled
